description: AGORA Sentinel: stablecoin depeg risk indicator. Reads the Chainlink price feed on-chain and returns the deviation from 1 USD in basis points, a 0-100 score, a level (calme / tendu / alerte), data age and staleness. A risk indicator, not investment advice and not a forecast. Price: $0.01 USDC per call, paid with x402.

network.description: EVM network, e.g. base, ethereum, polygon, arbitrum
